chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ismāʿīl ibn Marrār, from Yūnus, from Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAbd al-Khāliq, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: There is no objection to the elderly shaykh, the sick person, the woman, and the infirm bringing forward the tawaf of hajj before they depart to Minā.

key_terms.الْمَعْلُولُ: the infirm or physically impaired person
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْحَجِّ: the circumambulation associated with hajj rites
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection or legal problem
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the well-known hajj ritual location

ai.seo_question: Can the elderly, sick, women, or infirm perform the tawaf of hajj before going to Minā?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hajj rites. It states that certain excused individuals—such as the elderly, the sick, women, and the infirm—may perform the tawaf of hajj in advance before leaving for Minā.
